name: Motech Industries Inc.
summary: Motech Industries Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of solar products in Taiwan and internationally. It offers solar cells, PV modules, and PV power systems; and manufactures and sells PV inverters. The company also offers solar power converters; the design and installation of solar power systems; and the generation and sale of electricity from solar power equipment. Motech Industries Inc. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
